t0018-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0018-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0018-02.gloss: A field sketch and a water mark sit under the studio desk glass.
t0018-02.rival_reading: A reporter could sketch field reports and spill water while working; neither the stain nor the drawing identifies a program.
